author: Poag
description: Logs what games members are playing in a server: who's playing what, and how long each session lasts. Only 'Playing' activities count as games; other statuses (Spotify, custom statuses, streaming, watching) are ignored. Includes commands to list all games logged, the top 10 players of a given game, and the top 10 players across all games combined. Pairs with the separate voicelog cog: joining this cog's session data against voicelog's on user_id and overlapping time is the intended basis for a future relationship graph. Requires the Presence and Server Members privileged intents to be enabled for the bot.
install_msg: Thanks for installing GameLog! This cog requires the Presence and Server Members privileged intents to be enabled for the bot in order to see game activity - see the repo README for details.
short: Logs per-session game activity for members.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per server: a Discord user ID, the name of each detected game activity, and the start time, end time, and duration of each play session. This is used only to answer in-server playtime queries via this cog's commands, and may be used to derive relationship data (cross-referenced with the voicelog cog) in the future. All stored data for a user is deleted when Red processes a data deletion request for that user.
